faq.a: Aafiya is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aafiya written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aafiya is written عافية in Arabic and عافیہ in Urdu, and आफ़िया in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aafiya?
faq.a: The root of Aafiya is ع-ف-ي (ʿ-f-y).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aafiya?
Does Aafiya appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name itself; ʿāfiyah is an Arabic noun meaning well-being.
Aafiya renders the Arabic ʿāfiyah, meaning 'good health, well-being, soundness'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aafiya?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafiya total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aafiya?
faq.a: Aafiya appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aafia, Aafiyah.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aafiya?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aafiya include Aafia, Aafiyah.

faq.q: Is Aafiya the same as Aafia?
faq.a: Yes. Aafiya and Aafia are transliterations of the same Arabic ʿāfiyah (عافية).

faq.q: Where is the name Aafiya used today?
faq.a: Aafiya is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
